```{r}

adult_features

```

```{r}

adult_features <- adult_features %>%
  mutate(date_collected = as.Date(date_collected, '%m/%d/%y')) %>%
  #mutate(planting_date = as.Date(planting_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) %>%
  mutate_at(c('field_id', "previous_crop", "cover_crop", "manure", "tillage"), as.factor) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c('card_id', 'X', 'total_scm', 'scm_male', 'scm_female', 'florilega', 'season_total', 'male_total', 'female_total', 'weekly_prop', 'weekly_prop_f', 'weekly_prop_m', 'season_prop', 'date_collected'))


adult_features <- adult_features %>%
    mutate(previous_crop = case_when(previous_crop == 'Silage Corn' ~ 'Corn',
                           previous_crop == 'Grain Corn' ~ 'Corn',
                           previous_crop == 'Soybean' ~ 'Soybean',
                           TRUE ~ 'Other'))
  

adult_features <-adult_features %>% mutate_at('soil_texture', as.factor)
adult_features <-adult_features %>% mutate_at('year', as.factor)
adult_features <-adult_features %>% mutate_at('previous_crop', as.factor)
```

```{r}

plot(fitdist(adult_features$total_flies,"nbinom"))

```

```{r}
# Boruta with all features 

boruta <- Boruta(total_flies ~ ., data = na.exclude(adult_features), doTrace = 2, maxRuns = 500)

print(boruta)

png("boruta.png", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)
plot(boruta, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.35)

results <- attStats(boruta)
ordered_features <- results[order(-results$medianImp), ]
ordered_features

```



Dispersal (~1km/day before oviposition) - https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1570-7458.2012.01271.x
https://www.researchgate.net/publication/230003215_Dispersal_of_cabbage_root_fly

```{r}

features <- getSelectedAttributes(boruta, withTentative = F)
features

```

- Week
- Mean temp
- Dewpoint (removed due to correlation with mean temp)
- Prop corn, current year, 1000m
- VPD max
- Prop nat, previous year, 1000m
- pH

```{r}

options(na.action = "na.omit")

model_clean <- glmer.nb(total_flies ~ (scale(date_collected_numeric) + 
                                      scale(tmean_f) + 
                                      scale(vpdmax_hPa) + 
                                      scale(prop_corn_current_year_1000m) + 
                                      scale(prop_nat_previous_year_1000m) + 
                                      scale(ph))^2 + 
                                      (1 | field_id), 
                                      data = adult_features)

summary(model_clean)

vif_values <- vif(model_clean)
vif_values

```

```{r}

options(na.action = "na.fail")
model_clean_dredge <- dredge(model_clean, trace = TRUE, rank = "AICc")
nrow(model_clean_dredge)
model_clean_dredge[1,]

best_clean <- get.models(model_clean_dredge, delta==0)[[1]]
summary(best_clean)


vif_values <- vif(best_clean)
vif_values

```

```{r}

options(na.action = "na.omit")

model_week <- glmer.nb(total_flies ~ (scale(week) + 
                                      scale(tmean_f) + 
                                      scale(prop_corn_current_year_1000m) + 
                                      scale(prop_nat_previous_year_1000m) + 
                                      scale(ph))^2 + 
                                      (1 | field_id) + 
                                      (1 | year), 
                                      data = adult_features)

summary(model_week)

```


```{r}

# THIS IS THE ONE BEING WRITTEN ABOUT IN THE RESULTS

options(na.action = "na.fail")
model_week_dredge <- dredge(model_week, trace = TRUE, rank = "AICc")
nrow(model_week_dredge)
model_week_dredge[1,]

best_week <- get.models(model_week_dredge, delta==0)[[1]]
summary(best_week)

vif_values <- vif(best_week)
vif_values

```

```{r}

corn_nat_effect <- Effect(c("prop_nat_previous_year_1000m", "prop_corn_current_year_1000m"), best_week)

plot(corn_nat_effect, lines=list(col='#287a8c'), multiline = TRUE)


plot_predictions(best_week, condition = c("prop_nat_previous_year_1000m", "prop_corn_current_year_1000m"))

interact_plot(best_week, pred = 'prop_nat_previous_year_1000m', modx = 'prop_corn_current_year_1000m')


pdp_data <- partial(
    best_week,
    pred.var = c("prop_nat_previous_year_1000m", "prop_corn_current_year_1000m"),
    plot = FALSE,
    train = adult_features,
    rug = TRUE,
    chull = TRUE
    );

plotPartial(pdp_data, levelplot = TRUE, train = adult_features, contour = FALSE);

```

```{r}

temp_week_effect <- Effect(c("tmean_f", "week"), best_week, xlevels = list(week = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50)))


adult_features$week_group <- cut(adult_features$week, 
                    breaks = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 50), 
                    include.lowest = TRUE)

adult_features

ggplot(adult_features, aes(x = tmean_f, y = total_flies, color = week_group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +                                # Raw data points
  geom_smooth(method = "glm.nb", se = FALSE, size = 1, color='black') +     # Interaction slopes
  facet_wrap(adult_features$week_group) +
  facet_grid(cols=vars(adult_features$week_group)) +
  theme_bw()


plot(temp_week_effect,
     as.table=TRUE, 
     lattice = list(layout=c(5,1)))
     lines=list(col='#287a8c'), 
     residuals=TRUE)

plot_predictions(best_week, condition = c("tmean_f", "week"))

plot_predictions(best_week, condition = c("tmean_f", "week"), newdata = adult_features)

interact_plot(
  best_week, 
  pred = tmean_f,         
  modx = week,        
  plot.points = TRUE,          
  interval = TRUE,            
  jitter = 0.1              
)

pdp_data <- partial(
    best_week,
    pred.var = c("tmean_f", "week"),
    plot = FALSE,
    train = adult_features,
    rug = TRUE,
    chull = TRUE
    );

plotPartial(pdp_data, levelplot = TRUE, train = adult_features, contour = FALSE);


```
